Results.ReviewText:
Great grill. My wife and I assembled it ourselves and found the graphical instructions clear and complete. I had had an outside propane line installed from my in-ground tank and, though the instructions covered only a tank hanging on the grill, I was able to find a video online that showed me how to remove the regulator line and attach the hose from the external line to the grill. As long as I keep an eye on the gas level in my in-ground tank, I'll never run out.

Two absolutely essential accessories: the grill brush from Weber and a rapid read cooking thermometer. The brush cleans all the nasty bits off the grate very nicely. It takes a bit of elbow grease, but really does the job. Cooking with a thermometer has gotten us perfectly cooked pork chops, chicken and ribs... so far.
Results.Title: Grill love!

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
